title: Act3D: 3D Feature Field Transformers for Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
layout_note: A top row of four headed scene columns (Environment, 3D Feature Cloud, Coarse-to-fine 3D feature fields, Action Prediction) over a bottom bus (Instruction -> Language Encoder -> one long transformer bar -> rotation/open/collision outputs), with feature tags dropping onto the bar.
grouping: Column headings in small outlined white boxes; the three coarse-to-fine steps are the only content enclosed in a black rounded frame; the bottom feature tags are coloured pills; no other containers.
shapes_depth: Scenes are 3-D renders: a simulator image of the robot, point clouds coloured by feature with rainbow tones, red scattered ghost points that tighten to one point; small tilted feature-map tiles with blue rays projecting into the cloud; flat rounded pills for features; the transformer is one long bar with a pink-orange-green gradient fill; curved blue arrows between the coarse-to-fine copies; a red box marks the predicted gripper position.
proposed_highlight: The coarse-to-fine sampling is the only framed panel and the widest one; the transformer is the longest element and the only gradient-filled one.
lesson: Draw a coarse-to-fine search as three copies of the same scene inside one frame, the sample points shrinking from a dense cloud to a single point, joined by curved arrows.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF footer 'Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2023), Atlanta, USA.'. The whole figure is embedded as one raster in the PDF. 'other' element: feature-coloured point-cloud renders and tilted CLIP feature tiles.

arrangement.units: four headed columns of scene renders in the top row, the third enclosed in a black rounded frame; an unframed bottom bus of a language encoder, coloured feature pills and one transformer bar
arrangement.inputs_as: a rendered simulator image of the robot scene and the quoted instruction in a pink rounded box
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; outputs are Q_pos in a box at the top right and (Q_rot, Q_open, Q_col) as text at the bar's right end
arrangement.shared: one transformer bar receives language, occupied-point, ghost-point (two-way arrow) and proprioception inputs

taxonomy.task: language-conditioned multi-task manipulation: classify 3-D ghost points sampled coarse to fine in a lifted CLIP feature cloud

core.what: ghost points are drawn in the scene's feature cloud three times inside one frame - a dense red cloud, a tight cluster, a single point - so the coarse-to-fine search is seen on the scene itself

relations.form: red ghost points scattered over the scene render, and CLIP feature tiles lifted into the point cloud by blue rays
three copies of the same scene in one black frame, joined by curved blue arrows, the samples contracting each step
four headed columns left to right from environment image to action prediction, linked by a 'Ghost Point Sampling' arrow and a long arrow to Q_pos
language, occupied-point, ghost-point and proprioception pills converge on one long transformer bar from the left and above

channels.colour: pill fills name the token type (pink language, light blue occupied points, green ghost points, yellow proprioception) and the transformer bar's gradient blends them; point-cloud colours are feature values; red = ghost points and predicted position
channels.shape: outlined white boxes = column headings, rounded pills = feature tokens, long bar = transformer, renders = data
channels.line: two meanings on blue: straight blue rays lift feature tiles into 3-D, curved blue arrows step between coarse-to-fine copies; black arrows carry data, one two-way black arrow ties ghost features to the transformer
channels.frame: one black rounded frame = the iterative sampling unit

quality.strengths: The method's search is drawn on its data: the same scene three times with the red samples contracting, inside one frame. The lifted feature cloud is the real point cloud, not a box. The framed coarse-to-fine panel is the widest unit, so space follows the novelty.
quality.weaknesses: The tie between the transformer bar and each refinement step is not drawn - only a long diagonal line from the feature cloud down to the bar and a two-way arrow to the ghost tag - so how each step uses the transformer is not visible. Blue serves rays, step arrows and the occupied-feature pill. Outputs are split between a boxed Q_pos at the top right and a typeset tuple at the bottom right.

insights.structure: Scene renders run along the top in four headed columns, while the network is a single bus along the bottom whose transformer bar spans most of the width.
insights.data: Every scene stage is the real data: a simulator image, the CLIP-feature-coloured point cloud with tilted feature tiles beaming into it, and red ghost points in three refinement steps.
insights.emphasis: The coarse-to-fine steps are the only framed content and the widest panel; the transformer is the only gradient-filled element.
insights.flow: Left to right in both rows: a 'Ghost Point Sampling' arrow enters the frame, curved blue arrows step through it, a straight arrow leaves for Q_pos; the bottom bus runs from the instruction to the output tuple.
insights.avoid: Do not leave the network and the iterative panel it drives unconnected; a long diagonal from the top row to the bottom bus is not a substitute.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
